jobs.descr:
Responsibilities

  • Assemble and fit injection moulds
  • Support T1 trial and engineering changes
  • Maintain mould records and spare parts

Requirements

  1. 3+ years mould making experience
  2. Able to read 2D and 3D drawings
  3. Experience with 718H / S136 steel
jobs.descr_zh:
岗位职责

  • 负责注塑模具装配与配模
  • 配合 T1 试模与工程更改
  • 维护模具台账与备件

任职要求

  1. 3 年以上做模经验
  2. 能看懂 2D／3D 图纸
  3. 熟悉 718H／S136 钢材

jobs.descr:
Responsibilities

  • Set up machines from 50T to 250T
  • Adjust process parameters and solve defects
  • Keep hourly inspection records

Requirements

  1. Familiar with ABS / PC / PP / PMMA
  2. Experience with thin-wall and thick-wall parts
  3. Willing to work shifts
jobs.descr_zh:
岗位职责

  • 负责 50T-250T 注塑机上下模与调机
  • 调整工艺参数并处理不良
  • 填写每小时巡检记录

任职要求

  1. 熟悉 ABS／PC／PP／PMMA 材料
  2. 有薄壁件与厚壁件生产经验
  3. 可接受两班倒

jobs.descr:
Responsibilities

  • First-article and patrol inspection
  • Use callipers, height gauges and colour panels
  • Handle customer complaints with 8D reports

Requirements

  1. 2+ years plastic inspection experience
  2. Familiar with AQL sampling
  3. Careful and detail oriented
jobs.descr_zh:
岗位职责

  • 负责首件与巡检检验
  • 使用卡尺、高度规与色板
  • 配合处理客诉并输出 8D 报告

任职要求

  1. 2 年以上塑胶件检验经验
  2. 熟悉 AQL 抽检标准
  3. 细致认真，责任心强
